mechanism: Diclofenac inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially increasing armodafinil levels; armodafinil may induce CYP3A4, affecting diclofenac metabolism and increasing NSAID-related GI/renal risks.
action: Monitor for increased armodafinil side effects (headache, insomnia, anxiety) and enhanced diclofenac toxicity; consider alternative analgesic or dose adjustment with periodic renal function monitoring.
